summary.text: Ricky Hill is a Republican member of the Arkansas Senate for District 11, which covers parts of Lonoke and Pulaski counties.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Senate service beginning in 2019 and gives Hill's occupation as banker and farmer.

According to the Senate biography, Hill lives in Cabot, grew up on a farm in rural Lonoke County, graduated from Cabot High School and earned a master's degree in agriculture business and economics from Arkansas State University.
The biography says Hill is an executive vice president at Bank OZK and served on the Cabot School Board from 2012 through 2017.
